description: Fetch a URL, extract every JSON-LD (<script type="application/ld+json">) block, and validate basic structure — @context/@type presence plus required fields for common schema.org types (Article, Product, Organization, WebSite, LocalBusiness, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage). Reports per-block errors rather than failing the whole call on one bad block.
name: json_ld_schema_validator
